description: Type text into element_index, or into the focused element (of app, if given). mechanism auto (default): inserted through accessibility at the caret (AXSelectedText) — IME-safe, clipboard untouched, works in a background app, verified by reading the value back; replace:true sets the whole value instead. If the focused element takes no text through accessibility, auto falls back to physical keystrokes (not IME-safe; app is then a focus guard: refused unless that app is frontmost). mechanism physical forces keystrokes (clicking element_index first).
name: mac_type
